subject: An articulated action figure for the crowd-navigation character pipeline

references.instruction: Preserve the face, hair silhouette, clothing design, and color placement.
Use this reference for joint placement and assembly boundaries, not character identity.
Use the matte plastic finish. Do not copy this reference's markings or colors.

outputs.name: whole-character
outputs.purpose: Review the identity and proportions before generating component meshes.
requirements: Show the entire figure with separated limbs and an unobstructed silhouette.
Keep hands open and avoid accessories that hide the body.

outputs.name: torso
outputs.view: Straight front view of the isolated torso
outputs.purpose: Provide a clean image input for Hunyuan3D torso reconstruction.
requirements: Exclude the head, arms, and legs without inventing new clothing details.
Keep the neckline, waist boundary, and shoulder connections visible.

outputs.name: head
outputs.view: Neutral front three-quarter view of the isolated head
outputs.purpose: Provide a separate Hunyuan3D input while retaining the approved identity.
requirements: Preserve the whole-character face and hair shape.
Include the neck connection and avoid cropped hair.

invariants: All outputs depict the same figure; component requests do not authorize redesign.
Use a plain background and neutral lighting without a pedestal, props, or cast text.
Preserve the relative dimensions needed to assemble the components.
